skills.name: Wrapping Strike (缠击/纏撃)
skills.description: Ittan Mommen rushes forward to attack a single target, dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK. Also has a 100% base chance of inflicting them with Entangling Obstruction, lasts for 1 turn. ;Entangling Obstruction (纏わり阻害) : :'''Debuff, Status''': Decreases damage dealt by 15%.

upgrades.text: Duration for Entangling Obstruction increases to 2 turns.

skills.name: Snow Weaving (雪织/雪織)
skills.line: This is the intertwining of fate. No one can escape destiny.
skills.description:
Ittan Momen Binds an enemy, dealing damage equal to 80% of her ATK and inflicts 3 layers of Wrap. She steals 40% of HIT from the enemy as long as they are under Bind.
Using this skill on an enemy already inflicted with Bind again consumes all layers of Wrap, dealing damage equal to 185% of her ATK (each layer of Wrap consumed deals an extra 21% of damage).
When Ittan Momen receives damage from a normal attack, it removes a layer of Wrap from the enemy with Bind. ; : ;Wrap (巻き込み) : :'''Debuff, Mark''': Gradually tightens to decreases the target's SPD by 25. Increases by 1 layer at the end of the inflicted target's turn. ;Bind (束縛) : :Only 1 enemy can be bound at a time. Changing targets will cause all layers of Wrap to be removed. When Wrap expires, Bind will also be removed.

upgrades.text: Extra damage for each layer increases to 26%.
Extra damage for each layer increases to 31%.
Extra damage for each layer increases to 36%.
Also steals 40% of RES and 40% of Crit from the enemy as long as they are under Bind.

skills.name: Crimson Night (绯夜散华/緋夜散華)
skills.line: I will bloom in your scattered blood.
skills.description:
Ittan Momen launches a 4-strike attack on 1 enemy and the enemy with Bind, dealing damage equal to 45% of her ATK on the first 3 strikes and 125% of her ATK on the last hit. Then, inflicts 1 layer of Wrap on the enemy with Bind.
Does not launch multiple strikes if the targeted enemy and enemy with Bind are the same. ;Wrap (巻き込み) : :'''Debuff, Mark''': Gradually tightens to decreases the target's SPD by 25. Increases by 1 layer at the end of the inflicted target's turn. ;Bind (束縛) : :Only 1 enemy can be bound at a time. Changing targets will cause all layers of Wrap to be removed. When Wrap expires, Bind will also be removed.

upgrades.text: Damage of the final hit increases to 153%.
Damage of the final hit increases to 181%.
Damage of the final hit increases to 209%.
Gains 2 onibi if only 1 enemy is attacked.

bio.condition: With Ittan Momen win 30 times in Duel, Practice or Spar against Okuribito.
